methodology: Ten preselected real recalls (six anchors and four different-product traps), each run without then with the critic. Both arms execute runCase on identical committed data via LocalBackend; all new inference uses Nightshift and pinned NVIDIA Nemotron. Lightning replies are generated live once and shared within each pair, including the cartographer, to control worker sampling noise. Ultra is called live only in the critic arm; changed revision inputs can cause new worker calls. The baseline retains deterministic audits but has no senior model approval. No reporter is included in the scored pipeline. Physical HTTP attempts, shared response uses, elapsed time and receipts are reported separately. Each pair is capped at six minutes; the experiment is capped at 39 minutes. No incomplete arm is scored.
